environment.details: Synthetic bootstrap fixture; no real network or user data.

ground_truth.statement: The synthetic client has no IPv4 default route, so direct egress and DNS fail.

verification.details: The fixture directly controls every typed probe observation.

provenance.summary: Generated from typed in-memory observations solely to bootstrap the replay harness.

notes: Confidence is asserted here for the opposite reason: both paths are demonstrably dead, but nothing in the run separates a broken link from a broken upstream, so the conclusion is a state rather than a localized cause.
